card.name: The word after "one" in one-based phrases
card.fires_on: The word or hyphenated piece that follows "one" (or a number like seventy) and completes a set phrase, such as "one another", "one-six(th)", "one-on-one" and "oneself".

modes.label: Fractions with one
modes.description: The "-six" piece in "one-sixth" when a dose is given as a fraction.

modes.label: One another / oneself
modes.description: Reciprocal or reflexive words that follow "one".
modes.example: allow students to challenge one<< another>>’s ideas.

modes.label: One-on-one and number compounds
modes.description: The hyphenated piece in "one-on-one" or a compound like "seventy-one".
modes.example: they are too busy to offer one-on<<-one>> help.
